mapper.select: SELECT t.id, t.workflow_instance_id, t.tenant_id, t.application_id, t.task_key, t.round_no, t.status, t.decision, t.comment, t.completed_by, t.completed_at, t.created_at, t.reminder_at, t.reminded_at, t.due_at, t.escalated_at FROM workflow_tasks t JOIN workflow_instances i ON i.id = t.workflow_instance_id WHERE t.workflow_instance_id = #{workflowInstanceId, jdbcType=OTHER} AND t.round_no = i.review_round AND t.status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY CASE t.task_key WHEN 'PURCHASER_REVIEW' THEN 1 WHEN 'LEGAL_REVIEW' THEN 2 WHEN 'FINANCE_REVIEW' THEN 3 WHEN 'OPERATIONS_ESCALATION' THEN 4 WHEN 'OPERATIONS_ACTIVATION' THEN 5 ELSE 99 END

SELECT id, workflow_instance_id, tenant_id, application_id, task_key, round_no, status, decision, comment, completed_by, completed_at, created_at, reminder_at, reminded_at, due_at, escalated_at FROM workflow_tasks WHERE workflow_instance_id = #{workflowInstanceId, jdbcType=OTHER} AND status = 'COMPLETED' ORDER BY completed_at ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO workflow_tasks (id, workflow_instance_id, tenant_id, application_id, task_key, round_no, status, decision, comment, completed_by, completed_at, created_at, reminder_at, reminded_at, due_at, escalated_at) VALUES (#{id, jdbcType=OTHER}, #{workflowInstanceId, jdbcType=OTHER}, #{tenantId}, #{applicationId, jdbcType=OTHER}, #{taskKey}, #{roundNo}, #{status}, #{decision}, #{comment}, #{completedBy, jdbcType=OTHER}, #{completedAt}, #{createdAt}, #{reminderAt}, #{remindedAt}, #{dueAt}, #{escalatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE workflow_tasks SET status = #{status}, decision = #{decision}, comment = #{comment}, completed_by = #{completedBy, jdbcType=OTHER}, completed_at = #{completedAt} WHERE id = #{id, jdbcType=OTHER} AND status = 'PENDING'
mapper.select: SELECT id, workflow_instance_id, tenant_id, application_id, task_key, round_no, status, decision, comment, completed_by, completed_at, created_at, reminder_at, reminded_at, due_at, escalated_at FROM workflow_tasks WHERE status = 'PENDING' AND reminder_at <= #{now} AND reminded_at IS NULL ORDER BY reminder_at LIMIT 100 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED

SELECT id, workflow_instance_id, tenant_id, application_id, task_key, round_no, status, decision, comment, completed_by, completed_at, created_at, reminder_at, reminded_at, due_at, escalated_at FROM workflow_tasks WHERE status = 'PENDING' AND due_at <= #{now} AND escalated_at IS NULL AND task_key IN ('PURCHASER_REVIEW', 'LEGAL_REVIEW', 'FINANCE_REVIEW') ORDER BY due_at LIMIT 100 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE workflow_tasks SET status = 'CANCELLED' WHERE workflow_instance_id = #{workflowInstanceId, jdbcType=OTHER} AND round_no = #{roundNo} AND status = 'PENDING'
